Daman conditions require a valid visa, passport and photograph; coverage is not automatic for every international student. Use the portal/app health-card form and attach requested documents. The service is free with 5-day delivery; renewal is each May while enrollment and UAEU sponsorship continue. The page lists 800 8238 for assistance.
